decision: adopt dynamic PIE for release builds
scope: A07 linkage choice only; no A08 optimization, new APK qualification or router deployment
rationale: ELF is 3.66% smaller and restores observed ASLR/RELRO/NX. The original 24-window screen retains accepted=false for reload p95. A predeclared six-window targeted confirmation and all six retained reload pairs trigger no regression flag under the unchanged 10%/max-W/all-directions rule. A small latency cost remains visible and is accepted; no performance-equivalence claim.
pack_relative_relocs: Removed from recipe to match measured linkage strategy, not because image musl lacks RELR support.
limits: Oracle measurements do not establish Cortex-A53 performance.
The original failed screen is preserved, not reclassified as passing.
Range/median W is sensitive to extremes; all windows remain in evidence.
Only reload was repeated; preceding workload history differs from the initial screen.
New builds can differ by path remapping and SDK packaging; the frozen ELF hash remains mandatory.
No package creation, installation, upgrade, rollback or procd/ujail lifecycle validation was performed.
